output: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning using neural networks with multiple layers
Backpropagation is an algorithm that computes gradients to update neural network weights
Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes training data instead of learning general patterns
Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that minimizes loss by updating parameters
Transformers are neural network architectures using self-attention mechanisms
Attention allows models to focus on relevant parts of input when processing information
Fine-tuning adapts pre-trained models to specific tasks with additional training
Reinforcement learning trains agents through rewards and penalties for actions
Tokenization splits text into smaller units like words or subwords for processing
Embedding layers convert discrete tokens into continuous vector representations
